question: Should OpenClaw accept the persisted byte-compaction retry metadata and 1 MiB/10% material-growth hysteresis as the default retry policy for maxActiveTranscriptBytes preflight compaction?
rationale: The code path looks coherent and tested, but the choice changes when existing sessions compact again after an oversized active transcript remains above the byte threshold.

options.title: Accept Hysteresis Policy
options.body: Land the PR with the additive metadata and current retry thresholds, relying on focused tests and CI for the exact head.

options.title: Tune Before Merge
options.body: Change the growth window or metadata semantics first if owners want a different retry cadence for byte-triggered compaction.

options.title: Pause For Broader Compaction Policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want to resolve it together with the broader compaction-trigger issues before adding stored retry state.

recommendation.title: Accept Hysteresis Policy
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the additive metadata and current retry thresholds, relying on focused tests and CI for the exact head.
